WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN user_id::VARCHAR
      ELSE device_id::VARCHAR
    END AS identifier,
    session_start AS session_start_date,
    session_end AS session_end_date,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN user_id::VARCHAR
        ELSE device_id::VARCHAR
      END || session_start::VARCHAR || session_end::VARCHAR
    ) AS session_id
  FROM dwh.fact_segment_session
  WHERE session_duration != 0
    AND app_name = 'Pomelo - Web'
    AND DATE(session_start) >= DATE('2026-09-01')
),

base_events AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR) AS identifier, 'Sign in' AS event, 1 AS stage, "timestamp" AS event_time
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.sign_in_viewed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Login', 2, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.logged_in
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), ref_type AS event, 3, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.product_list_viewed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Hero Banner', 3, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.product_list_viewed
  WHERE ref_type NOT IN ('home_slider', 'home_masonry', 'navigation', 'app_feed')

  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Product Viewed', 4, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.product_viewed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Quick Add to Cart', 5, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.quick_add_to_cart
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Product Added', 6, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.product_added
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Cart Viewed', 7, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.cart_viewed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Wishlist Viewed', 8, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.wishlist_product_added_to_cart
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Shipping Address Selected', 9, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.shipping_address_selected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Payment Method Selected', 11, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.payment_method_selected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(user_id::VARCHAR, anonymous_id::VARCHAR), 'Order Completed', 12, "timestamp"
  FROM rudderstack_web_production.order_completed
),

base AS (
  SELECT s.session_id, e.event, e.stage, e.event_time
  FROM base_events e
  JOIN sessions s
    ON e.identifier = s.identifier
   AND (e.event_time + INTERVAL '7 hour') >= (s.session_start_date - INTERVAL '30 minute')
   AND (e.event_time + INTERVAL '7 hour') <= (s.session_end_date + INTERVAL '30 minute')
),

ranked AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    event,
    stage,
    event_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY session_id, stage
      ORDER BY event_time
    ) AS seq
  FROM base
),

dedupe AS (
  SELECT session_id, event, stage, event_time
  FROM ranked
  WHERE seq = 1
),

next_step AS (
  SELECT
    a.session_id,
    a.event AS source,
    b.event AS target,
    a.stage AS source_stage,
    b.stage AS target_stage,
    a.event_time
  FROM dedupe a
  JOIN dedupe b
    ON a.session_id = b.session_id
   AND b.stage = (
      SELECT MIN(c.stage)
      FROM dedupe c
      WHERE c.session_id = a.session_id
        AND c.stage > a.stage
   )
)

SELECT
  source,
  target,
  source_stage,
  target_stage,
  DATE(event_time + INTERVAL '7 hour') AS event_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS value
FROM next_step
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY value DESC;
